note: quote-anchored:valueText=官方原文,本脚本每轮验证其仍在页面上;字段语义见 basis。多个合格课程可合并时长来确定 PGWP 长度;官方措辞为 may,不保证签发。

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You can apply for a 3-year PGWP, even if your master's program was less than 2 years
requirements.label: Master's degree >=8 months -> 3-year PGWP

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: We may give you a PGWP that's valid for up to the same length as your study program
requirements.label: Program 8 months to <2 years -> PGWP up to same length

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: If your program was 2 years or more
requirements.label: Program 2 years or more -> 3-year PGWP

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You may be able to get a PGWP that combines the length of each program as long as you meet the eligibility requirement for each program
requirements.label: More than 1 program: lengths may combine (each PGWP-eligible & >=8 months; higher language req applies)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You can't get a PGWP if you already had one after completing an earlier program of study
requirements.label: One PGWP per lifetime

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you apply for your PGWP within 180 days of confirmation that you completed your program of study
requirements.label: Apply within 180 days of completion confirmation

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: was at least 8 months long (or 900 hours for Quebec programs)
requirements.label: Program must be at least 8 months (900 hours for Quebec programs)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: minimum level of Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB) 7 in English
requirements.label: University degree/program graduates: CLB 7 in all 4 areas

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: minimum level of Canadian Language Benchmarks (CLB) 5 in English
requirements.label: College/polytechnic/non-university graduates: CLB 5 in all 4 areas
